mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending power and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 4.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand, which triggers a sell-off in equities as corporate revenue expectations are revised downward, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have declined for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of sustained industrial production growth above 1.5% year-over-year, supply chain bottlenecks ease and corporate margins expand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO YoY growth exceeds 1.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 4.0%, it signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 per month indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals robust demand growth that supports corporate revenue expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100.0 on a 3-month moving average), supply chain disruptions intensify, reducing corporate output and profitability, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO 3-month MA is below 100.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
